description: This file defines the interface IStateObserver for observing application state changes within the Rialto server manager service. It declares a pure virtual method 'stateChanged' that must be implemented by clients to handle state change notifications.

classes.name: IStateObserver
classes.description: An interface class that allows clients to subscribe to application state change notifications. It declares a pure virtual method 'stateChanged' to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: A pure virtual method that must be implemented by subclasses to handle notifications when an application's state changes. It takes the application ID and the new session server state as parameters.
